info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Product API
Returns properties of one or more products based on product ID(s).

params.name: productIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs to look up

items.docs:
Results include properties from all sections available in the UI: Product Properties, Advanced Settings, Requests, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts.

Assigning “0” to Product ID would return the payload to create a new product.

info.name: Return products that match all provided parameters.

params.name: statusId
params.description: Product status ID. “0” for active and “1” for inactive

params.name: includeAdvanceSettings
params.description: Include Advance settings section in the response

params.name: includeRequest
params.description: Include Request settings section in the response

params.name: includeInsight
params.description: Include insights section in the response

params.name: includeTargeting
params.description: Include Target and Scheduling section in the response

params.name: includeAlerts
params.description: Include alerts section in the response

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results that is returned per page. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: All parameters are optional, and you may include any of them to customize the query. To pass multiple values for a parameter, provide a comma-separated list. If no parameters are passed, then details for all active products are returned. Results include properties from all sections available in the UI: Product Properties, Advanced Settings, Requests, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts. info.name: Create a new product per the request body.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the created object in the response body. Otherwise the response body will only return the created object ID.

items.docs: The request body must include all required product properties and may include any optional properties as well. To get a sample payload to pass along with the request, refer InternalLink[Product Details by ID Endpoint,operations-tag-Product,operations-Product-get_v2_products__productIds_]. Assign “0” to product ID when creating a new product.

info.name: Update a property of an existing product.

params.name: productId
params.description: Product ID to update a product.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body (do not pass the whole object.) The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.

* **path** – The path property indicates the element to update. The entire path with slashes needs to be provided here. Example: /status/id
